correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed Δ4 from 180 disconnected 4-sets in the precisely defined 11-vertex 20-edge Grötzsch graph, giving f=(11,55,165,330,462,431,180). Independent exact face/matching reconstruction yields 812 unaugmented matched pairs, one critical vertex, four critical 5-faces and five critical 6-faces. Directed Hasse graph topological sort confirms acyclicity on all 1634 nonempty faces; signed integral Morse gradient reductions give the zero 4x5 differential. With no cells of dimensions 1-4, the 5-skeleton is ∨4 S5; Hurewicz identifies 6-cell attachment degrees with π5, hence all attach trivially. Pure dimension6 and nonzero H5 obstruct shellability. Finite computation is exhaustive because all 11 vertices are enumerated.
